_about: Sea step 8 RANDOM ENCOUNTERS (director 2026-11-18: enemies come as random encounters while sailing, weighted by region, weather and night; pirate ships both by size: small ones fire broadsides from range, big ones also board (8b); loot both: floating debris + drops on deck after a boarding fight). The HOST rolls (core/sea/encounter_rules.gd) every check_seconds for each player at sea outside the safe waters round the home port: chance = base x region[n] x weather x night x (anchored or moving), capped by max_foes alive; a kind is picked by weight among the kinds allowed in that region / at that hour; it comes in spawn_m away within spawn_cone_deg of the player's ship's bow (or of his facing when swimming). Pirates (core/sea/pirate_rules.gd): engage between range_m, fire when the target lies within the cannon arc and fire_range_m, flee below flee_hull, give up beyond lose_m from every player. A pirate ship sunk leaves flotsam (game/sea_flotsam.gd): count pieces, each with doubloons x the region's loot_mult, a few materials, and a chance of a rolled gun at the region's item level. ALL NUMBERS PLACEHOLDERS.

crews._about: Sea step 8b: pirate crews on deck (core/sea/deck_walk.gd, game/sea_crews.gd). Musketeers shoot at players within see_m; cutlass men and the captain fight whoever stands on their deck. A boarder (kind 'boarders' > 0) closes to board_keep_m abeam of a player's ship and, within board_m, swings that many of her crew across one after another (cutlass men and the captain first). Crew are tougher by region (hp/damage_per_region) and count as tier_first + tier_per_region * (region - 1) for kill XP. Beating off the boarders leaves deck_loot chests on the defended deck; clearing a foe's own deck leaves them on hers and she strikes (no guns, no sail).
